numerical_contract.U_plus: U_plus(k,n,eta)=1 if n=0 or k=n; otherwise BetaPPF(1-eta;k+1,n-k)
numerical_contract.binomial_p_value: p_mj=1 if A_mj=0; otherwise P[X<=K_mj] for X~Binomial(A_mj,alpha), inclusive of K_mj
numerical_contract.holm_rejection: reject in order while p_(r)<=delta_r/(M-r+1), inclusive; the first failure stops rejection of all later candidates
numerical_contract.holm_adjusted_p: min(1,max_{s<=r}((M-s+1)*p_(s))) in sorted order, mapped back to candidate_index
numerical_contract.decision_precision: pinned float64 and pinned SciPy implementation; no tolerance may change a pass or fail decision

formulae.H_risk: p_m=max_j BinomCDF(K_mj;A_mj,alpha), with p_mj=1 when A_mj=0; apply Holm across M=12 at delta_r

proposal_contract.pooling: all proposal-domain records pooled without domain reweighting
proposal_contract.error: accepted unknown-class records and accepted incorrectly classified known-class records
proposal_contract.eligibility: A>=1 and K/A<=gamma*alpha by exact integer cross multiplication
proposal_contract.objective: maximum accepted proposal count; smaller threshold breaks a tie

selection.eligible: proposal-feasible candidates satisfying the procedure-specific risk decision and strictly positive coverage LCB
selection.tie_break: larger coverage LCB, then smaller gamma, then lexical score alias, then smaller candidate_index
selection.refusal: refuse exactly when no candidate is eligible

confidence_scope.unit: one model cell and one separately reported procedure after within-family selection

metrics.ECA: certified indicator multiplied by selected coverage LCB; zero for refusal, proposal infeasibility, or terminal scientific model failure
metrics.certification_rate: certified model cells divided by all 30 planned cells
metrics.CondCertCov: mean selected coverage LCB among certified cells; NA with an explicitly reported zero denominator when no cell certifies
metrics.S_minus_B: paired mean ECA difference; client-count division effect
metrics.H_minus_S: paired mean ECA difference; Holm residual effect
metrics.H_minus_B: paired mean ECA difference; total headline contrast

invalid_invariants.evidence_equality: H, S, and B use identical (n,A,K) arrays and the same count-tensor hash within every model and audit configuration
candidate_level: C_H equals C_S within replay tolerance
S risk pass implies H risk pass
B risk pass implies S risk pass
B candidate certification implies S candidate certification implies H candidate certification
cell_level: B certification implies S certification implies H certification
the selected member exactly follows the frozen objective and tie break
candidate-level rows aggregate exactly to the primary procedure summary
invalid_invariants.interpretation: Any violation is INVALID, not PASS_CORE_ONLY or a scientific negative. Equality is a scientifically possible outcome.

decision_gates.PASS_CORE_ONLY: all absolute H utility gates pass but at least one nonnegative, integrity-valid S-minus-B gain gate fails
decision_gates.VALID_NEGATIVE: complete valid experiment in which at least one absolute H utility gate fails
decision_gates.HOLD_INCOMPLETE: any registered model or verifier outcome is missing
decision_gates.INVALID: any protocol, leakage, hash, implementation, evidence-equality, count-ordering, or monotonicity breach
PASS_FRESH_SEED_REPLICATION: H certifies at least 6 of 30 models
H certification appears in both architectures
H certification appears in at least 3 of 5 class splits
mean H ECA is at least 0.05
mean S-minus-B ECA is at least 0.01
architecture-specific mean S-minus-B is nonnegative for both architectures
each architecture contains at least one strict positive S-minus-B cell
all integrity and independent-replay checks pass

registered_audit_grid.secondary_definition: all registered pairs except the primary pair

descriptive_bootstrap.resampling: paired resampling of the three training seeds within each fixed architecture-by-split stratum
descriptive_bootstrap.scope: conditional training-RNG variation; not theorem confidence or source-population inference

mandatory_reporting: all 30 model cells and all 90 primary procedure rows
proposal infeasibility and terminal scientific model failure
all refusals and deterministic refusal labels
all candidate raw and adjusted Holm p-values
all candidate S and B risk UCBs
primary and secondary results kept distinct
